meta.homeDescription: We help SMBs migrate, protect, and optimize Microsoft 365 and Azure. Free security audit, expert support, and real guidance.

structured.orgDescription: Expert consulting in Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, and cybersecurity. Secure cloud migration and technical support for SMBs in Latin America and worldwide.

faq.name: What does the free security audit include?

acceptedAnswer.text: We review critical points of Microsoft 365 (MFA, forwarding, conditional access, roles, connected apps, SharePoint/OneDrive, anti-phishing, retention, and logs) and deliver a prioritized report.

faq.name: How long does it take to migrate to Microsoft 365?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the size and current state. We plan the migration to minimize impact and keep operations running during the process.

faq.name: Do you work outside of Argentina?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We provide remote services to Latin America, the United States, and Europe, with adapted schedules and communication.

faq.name: What advantages does Azure have for an SMB?

acceptedAnswer.text: Azure offers enterprise-level infrastructure on a pay-as-you-go basis. We design an architecture that prioritizes continuity and cost without over-provisioning.

items.q: What does the free security audit include?
items.a: In a 30-minute session we review the most sensitive points of your Microsoft 365. You take away a clear, understandable and actionable diagnosis, even if you decide not to move forward with us.

items.q: How long does it take to migrate to Microsoft 365?
items.a: It depends on the size and current state. For many SMBs, the migration can be planned to minimize impact and keep email operational during the process.

items.q: Do you only work with companies in Argentina?
items.a: Our base is Argentina, but we provide remote service to Latin America, the US, and Europe. We adjust schedules and communication to make it simple.

items.q: What advantage does Azure have for an SMB?
items.a: You access enterprise-level infrastructure paying per use. We design an architecture that prioritizes continuity and cost, without over-provisioning.

content.history_p2: Founded by a team of cloud architecture specialists led by Microsoft Azure certified experts, our firm understands the specific challenges of both local and international markets. We help businesses transition seamlessly from the physical to the digital world, strengthening their security and increasing productivity.
content.m1_d: Proactive protection of your most valuable assets through constant audits and industry best practices.
content.m2_d: We eliminate unnecessary cloud spend so that every dollar invested generates direct value for your business.
content.m3_d: We don't just implement; we guide and educate you so that technology is an ally, not a barrier.
